time_predictor.scope: Arrival-law hypothesis only, NOT physical flux correction or a solver validation

spatial_fields.extensive_weighting: Physical overlap/fine volume: preserves fuel joules and oxygen kg
spatial_fields.scope: Observed field redistribution diagnostic, no fabricated heat/mass fluxes or fitted time shifts
